principle: Each domain and operationalisation selects a deterministic structural edit family. The selected profile controls its magnitude. No edit encodes desirability, reward, utility, value, performance, success or quality.

D1_spatial_planning.state_semantics: spatial nodes and directed spatial relations

D2_resource_planning.state_semantics: resource nodes and directed allocation relations

D3_graph_reconfiguration.state_semantics: graph nodes and directed graph edges

O2_topology.primary_effect: add profile.dependency_count directed relations with deterministic endpoints

O5_composition.primary_effect: apply cardinality, topology, depth and constraint edits in that fixed order
O5_composition.secondary_effect: all four components remain explicitly represented in the realized transformation

profile_binding.reachable_change_count: controls number of newly created domain elements
profile_binding.composition_depth: controls number of ordered composition layers
profile_binding.dependency_count: controls number of directed structural dependencies

determinism.element_ids: lowest unused integer identifiers in ascending creation order
determinism.relation_endpoints: deterministic canonical endpoints derived from creation order
determinism.serialization: canonical JSON with sorted keys and deterministic arrays

t_acc.enumeration: all actions A/B/C/D crossed with all slots slot_1..slot_4
t_acc.operator: same D×O matrix and profile binding as the realized transition
t_acc.validity: finite bounds, existing endpoints, syntactically valid structural constraints
